expected.title: TotemRemnant
expected.description: Carry upgradeable backpacks, combine protective modules, recover eligible items after death, and crystallize Echo Shards from sculk.

expected.title: TotemDiscordBridge
expected.description: Relay Minecraft chat, player events, and server status to Discord through a separately configured HTTPS Worker.

changes.description: Connect Minecraft chat and server events to Discord, link player accounts, and manage an optional external bridge through in-game controls.

expected.title: Totem Villagers
expected.description: Build a village economy where workers use real materials, food, tools, goods, and emeralds to produce their trade stock.

changes.description: Build a working village economy with stocked trades, material-backed professions, woodcutters, builders, guard posts, and mangrove villages.

expected.title: Totemvt
expected.description: Sort inventories, adjust survival recipes and blocks, and let authorized administrators observe supported player screens.

changes.description: Sort inventory, fill bookshelves, recover furnace XP through hoppers, and observe supported player interfaces with read-only administrator tools.

expected.title: TotemEnchanting
expected.description: Use the books inside Chiseled Bookshelves to increase enchanting power, with a higher ceiling and particle feedback.

changes.description: Build enchanting power with real books, unlock offers beyond level 30, and extend Bane of Arthropods to skeleton-family enemies.

expected.title: Totem Locksmith
expected.description: Control access to connected chests, barrels, and hopper networks with padlocks, keys, and configurable permissions.

changes.description: Lock chest, barrel, and hopper networks with padlocks, physical keys, role-based access, friendships, and automation permissions.

expected.title: TotemLibrary
expected.description: Shared foundation for Totem mods: one growing in-game manual, persistent friendships, optional integrations, and reusable server/client APIs.

expected.title: TotemAlchemy
expected.description: Discover potion effects through experiments, record personal research, and cook mixtures in heated cauldrons.

changes.description: Discover multi-effect potions, research ingredients, manage cauldron heat, and turn everyday materials into gunpowder and new drinks.

expected.title: Totem Excavation
expected.description: Select mining areas with seven tiers of hammers, and harvest and replant mature crops with a hoe.

changes.description: Excavate selected areas with seven tiers of hammers, or harvest and replant mature crops with compatible hoes.

expected.title: TotemAutomata
expected.description: Configure Copper Golems to sort storage and gather resources using tools, fuel, work areas, and optional AI rules.

changes.description: Turn copper golems into configurable sorting and gathering helpers, with manual filters, tools, furnace routing, and optional AI classification.

expected.title: TotemNexus
expected.description: Build lodestone travel networks with maps, shared destinations, safe teleport checks, optional death recovery, and configurable distributed spawns.
